args.name: Open and inspect a hazelnut sample
args.function: Provide a physically feasible way to open one owned hazelnut and inspect its contents, preserving any usable kernel separately if possible. Do not eat it or infer food safety from appearance.
args.conditions: I own two freshly gathered hazelnuts and am near their plant. I have no tools. Hazelnut nutrition, toxicity, and preparation requirements are not established in my personal knowledge.
args.inputs: One owned hazelnut; any additional tool or material requirement must be stated rather than assumed available.
args.costs: Method, time, effort, and required tools are unknown. Use only actually available resources and identify prerequisites before execution.
args.effects: Enable a real opening and inspection trial if feasible, with observations of contents and preservation of recoverable material. No automatic nutritional or toxicity knowledge.

candidates.function: Press a small sample of your own material onto nearby ground to see whether it leaves a visible mark; if so, draw up to three short strokes there.
candidates.costs: Study: 1 round. test: sourceId, exact id of your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated stack; x, y, a ground point at most 0.5 from you that you see now, not water, a body or a solid object; budget 0.1-1 in tenths (default 0.1) for the test and strokes; floor (default 0) must stay in the source, which needs floor + budget. One round: the probe press at load 0.5, 0.5 energy and 0.1 of the source; after a visible mark, budget - 0.1 is reserved. draw: strokes, 1-3, each 2-4 points as x, y offsets from the test point, total length at most 0.3, material 0.1-0.3 from the reserve; per stroke one round, 0.2 energy and that material, continuing each round; draw again resumes a pause. cancel: one round, no energy. Checks run before any charge; an applicator is refused (only hand contact is represented).
candidates.effects: The press records the probe load response. A sample that does not hold the load and has no flexibility pulps and releases its liquid share (its water record, else the food water composition, else its moisture property); 1/4 stays on your hand, the rest reaches the ground; solids are waste. Firm forest floor, meadow or rocky ground keeps it; a wet bank or waterlogged ground disperses it. Colour: the material colour at 0.6 opacity times coverage over the ground tone; contrast is the 0-1 colour distance, visible from 0.05. Only a visible test allows drawing, on that ground type; strokes are 0.02 wide. Deposits form a ground mark nearby people see, with geometry, amounts, colour, contrast and coverage; branching is reported only where visible strokes meet with three arms. Durability is untested: no rain, smearing or fading rule exists. A failed recheck or an unworked round pauses at no charge. The unused reserve returns at completion or cancel and drops at death. Nothing is refunded; no food, reward or comfort.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general operation, Open and separate a material sample. The retrieved probe contract covers observation and a 0.1-unit press trial, but does not establish whole-specimen opening, conserved shell/content products or recovery of usable contents. The related-capability search found no equivalent opening operation. Reuse probe's applicable observation and contact-validation code rather than claiming it as new work. Lin owns hazelnuts but has no established opening tools or support surface; approval supplies neither those resources nor a guaranteed bare-hand opening.\",\"specification\":\"Handoff in the existing current-conversation development process: implement open-and-separate-sample(sourceId, quantity, method, toolId?, supportRef?, workId?) as a general operation for owned discrete enclosed materials. Initial quantity is one intact specimen; methods are hand compression and supported tool compression. Both use the same work and separation mechanism, not separate diagnostic abilities. Only admit supported compression when an actually present, reachable rigid support and an owned or otherwise legitimately usable blunt compression tool have independently validated physical properties. No stone, hammer, anvil, container or clean surface is supplied. Do not use teeth or sharp-impact methods. Bare-hand opening is permitted only if implemented grip and safe hand-force limits can overcome the actual enclosure response; otherwise report that it cannot open under this method. Nearness to a plant does not establish a suitable support or tool.\\nReferences and prerequisites: resolve sourceId to a currently reachable, owned, unreserved stack and reserve one whole specimen. For Lin the candidate is item-11-lin-113, resource hazelnut, quantity 2; item-3-lin-26 is not an input. The plant start-1-nuts is neither consumed nor treated as equipment. Validate actor life, capacity to manipulate, distance, ownership, available energy, tool/support condition and permissions before every worked round. Do not require food-safety knowledge to open, and never infer edibility, nutrition, toxicity or preparation requirements from opening.\\nImplementation dependencies: reuse and record open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, for compatible visible observation/contact checks; use its existing interface and full costs if a separate probe is actually invoked. Reuse the material-response and material-accounting helpers underlying apply-marking-material where applicable, recording exact implementation revisions in the handoff. Do not call its marking interface or charge its 0.1-unit destructive sample cost as though it implemented whole-nut opening. Add only missing enclosure fracture, recoverable-content separation and conserved product-state handling. Resolve physical enclosure strength, applied safe force, composition and recoverability from implemented material definitions; if those mechanisms or definitions are missing, implement and test them in this handoff before enabling execution. Do not expose hidden material properties as actor knowledge. Unknown response must not default to easy opening or free kernel production.\\nCosts and progress: proposed study cost is one simulation round, individually undertaken. A validated opening attempt costs one round and 0.5 energy, reserving one specimen but not automatically consuming its entire mass. If an opening exposes separable contents, a subsequent manual inspection/separation round costs 0.2 energy. Additional force attempts require an explicit new action with their full cost; no automatic repeated crushing. The opening round records applied method and actual intact/cracked/open/crushed response. The separation round records observable contents and moves only physically recoverable material into separate products. Inspection of an unopened specimen reports only its exterior and inability to inspect the interior. A tool requirement discovered at validation blocks execution without advancing work or charging energy. No resources are spent during development/review waiting.\\nConservation: remove exactly one specimen from the source only when committed to the work record; retain the other hazelnut untouched. Carry the selected specimen's actual mass, constituents, decay and provenance into the work record. After fracture, account for all material as remaining enclosure, recovered contents, attached contents, fragments and unrecoverable residue, with their sum equal to the input. Fracture does not multiply food units, reset spoilage, detoxify or create nutrition. If no usable kernel is recoverable, produce no recovered-kernel item. Implement fractional component accounting if required rather than rounding each output up to a whole nut. Tools and supports remain present with any modeled wear or damage; they are not consumed without an actual physical effect. Do not invent a support deposit or storage vessel. Output objects occupy a real reachable location or available inventory, subject to existing capacity rules.\\nLifecycle: store workId, actor, source and equipment references, reserved specimen, method, completed stage and all physical changes. Each stage commits atomically. Interruption, loss of reach, insufficient energy or loss of a required tool pauses before the next stage without further charges. Resume by workId after revalidation; never recreate the original intact specimen after fracture. Cancellation releases only untouched reservations; altered material is returned as its actual intermediate state or left at the work location. Completed energy expenditure, elapsed rounds, damage and lost material are never refunded. Death ends active work, releases usable reservations under existing death/drop ownership rules and leaves all altered material at its actual location; it neither restores the nut nor finishes separation. There is no passive processing, automatic maintenance or recurring energy drain. Intermediate and final material continues ordinary decay; reuse of equipment requires checking its actual condition.\\nCompletion produces an auditable opening/separation event and observable products, or an explicit intact/failed/incomplete outcome. Record only actually observed colour, shape, texture, visible damage and exposed contents, with evidence references and visibility limits. No eating, safety certification, nutrition knowledge, automatic communication, transfer, participant consent or mastery is included. Implement these checks and transitions in code, not repeated model adjudication.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Review experience separately from opening success. Request submission, development, study, interface naming and merely asking for inspection earn nothing. A completed physical trial may supply verified information, including an informative failure such as a demonstrable inability to open this specimen with the applied method. If supported by the ordinary nonprotected experience-event system, allow at most 0.1 short-lived pleasure for a genuinely informative, personally applicable observed result, with a ten-round cooldown and functional deduplication by material, method, conditions and learned finding; repeating an unchanged failure is not a new finding. Reuse established decay and aggregate caps, and do not credit an event until its evidence exists. No automatic sustained satisfaction for this single trial; later legitimate practice may qualify only through actual participation and established maintenance rules. No comfort, nutrition, healing or energy reward is inherent in opening. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, basic nutrition is unaffected by mood, and protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions remain unchanged.\",\"visualReview\":\"Add reusable visual metadata for sample-opening work and its products: operation, workId, source reference, actual stage, method, actor contact pose, tool/support references when present, enclosure geometry and colour, visible fracture state, exposed-content geometry, separate-product references and observable residue. Emit started, attempted, fractured/opened, separated, paused, cancelled and failed events only when their corresponding transitions occur. Share the same functional state across events and rendering. An intact or insufficient-force trial must remain visually intact; a paused or incomplete separation must not display a recovered kernel or success badge. Product appearances reflect actual exposed material, not an assumed healthy edible kernel. Rendering confers no knowledge or experience, reveals no hidden composition and does not make absent tools appear.\"}]}"}
